title: plugin-manifest — UPSTREAM BASE v2 (authored by Anthropic/Claude Code, not by IS)
description: The v2 upstream projection of the plugin-manifest contract: the `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` field shape owned by Claude Code. THIS FILE IS A REGENERATION OF THE CAPTURED PROJECTION (DR-062 § 5.1) — it encodes ONLY what the upstream documents (documented fields only, upstream requiredness, upstream wire forms), never an IS-specific rule. IS-specific required fields and constraints live in is-overlay/plugin-manifest.v2.json. Per DR-062 the v2 base adopts the two Class-1 findings of the plugin-manifest deep capture (058 #1: the 11 unmodeled component-path fields — agents, channels, dependencies, experimental.monitors, experimental.themes, hooks, lspServers, mcpServers, outputStyles, skills, userConfig; 058 #3: the documented metadata fields $schema, defaultEnabled, displayName) and the Class-2 widening (058 #2: `commands` accepts the documented string|array union — the array-only narrowing was an IS projection choice and is relocated to the overlay). The Class-3 relocations REMOVE two v1-base encodings with no documented machine-readable provenance: the structural kebab pattern + 64-char cap on `name` (upstream documents kebab-case in PROSE only — 058 #5) and the kernel-only `metadata` extension object (058 #4) — both now live in the overlay. Upstream requiredness: 'If you include a manifest, `name` is the only required field' ⇒ required:[name].
$comment: PROVENANCE (v2 — DR-062). REGENERATION SOURCE: intent-eval-lab specs/_vendor/upstream/plugin-manifest/projection.json (projection_version spec-projection/v1, spec_version unversioned-2026-06-12, sha256 a6a67a15e5ddc67c9797e1264481124f42dcf0187e4b85ffea5e27bfad56d632) — per DR-062 § 5.1 the projection is the regeneration source for this base, not a reference. Adjudication: 062-AT-DECR-tier3-reconciliation-authoring-v2-bases-2026-06-12 (acting-CTO ruling; plugin-manifest rows: C1 = 058 #1/#3, C2 = 058 #2, C3 = 058 #4/#5). Authority: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference § 'Plugin manifest schema' (Required fields + Metadata fields + Component path fields tables). VERBATIM upstream facts encoded here, per the projection's fields table: (1) 'If you include a manifest, name is the only required field' (projection name_only_required: true; manifest itself optional — manifest_optional: true). (2) name = string, 'Unique identifier (kebab-case, no spaces)' — kebab-case is PROSE ONLY (projection name_kebab_case_prose: true), so the v2 base types name as a bare string; the structural pattern + cap are the OVERLAY's (DR-062 C3, 058 #5). (3) Metadata table: $schema string; version string ('Semantic version' — no pinned grammar); description string; displayName string; author OBJECT (documented example {name,email,url} — the inner name requiredness carries from the v1 base, an AGREEMENT in the 058 cross-check, not a divergence); homepage string ('Documentation URL', format:uri carried as an agreement); repository string ('Source code URL', format:uri carried); license string; keywords array ('Discovery tags', items string carried — 'a keywords value that is a string instead of an array is a load error'); defaultEnabled boolean. (4) Component-path table: commands/agents/skills/outputStyles = string|array (058 #2 widens commands to the documented union; the same union is the documented form for the other three); hooks/mcpServers/lspServers = string|array|object (a config path, an array of paths, or an inline object); channels/dependencies = array (no documented item shape — the base mirrors the projection's bare `array`); experimental = the dotted projection rows experimental.monitors + experimental.themes, each string|array, folded into one object property; userConfig = object. (5) 'Unrecognized top-level fields are ignored' (projection unrecognized_top_level_ignored: true) ⇒ no additionalProperties:false. (6) 'Fields with the wrong type still fail' (projection wrong_type_fails: true) ⇒ every documented field carries its documented type. NOTE: the base intentionally does NOT cap description length — the universal disclosureMarkers fold (v2: 1024) is the operative IS cap. NOTE: the kernel-only `metadata` extension object moved to the overlay per DR-062 Class 3 (058 #4 — documented fields only in the base).
